text: Official CLI installable via a one-line shell script on macOS, Linux, and Git Bash
quote: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash   # macOS / Linux / Git Bash

text: Fullscreen, mouse-interactive terminal UI for coding with agents
quote: The TUI provides a rich, mouse-interactive, fullscreen experience for coding with agents.

text: Ask the agent to explain a repo or walk through a specific file referenced with @
quote: Useful first prompts: Explain this repo. @src/main.rs Walk me through this file.

text: Supports any custom model configured in the user-level config file
quote: Grok supports any custom model. Add it to your user-level config file, `~/.grok/config.toml`

text: The grok-4.7 model is available on the xAI API for use in your own agent loops, IDE integrations, or tools
quote: `grok-4.7`, SpaceXAI's latest model, is available directly on the xAI API. Drop it into your own agent loop, IDE integration, or coding tool.

text: Headless mode for scripts, bots, and other machine-friendly tasks
quote: Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.

text: Headless output can be plain, JSON, or streaming JSON
quote: `--output-format <FMT>` | Choose `plain`, `json`, or `streaming-json`

text: Runs as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout
quote: This runs Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout.

text: Plan mode explores the codebase and drafts a plan for approval before editing
quote: In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.

text: Auto mode uses a classifier to auto-approve safe tools while dangerous ones may still prompt
quote: Auto | Classifier auto-approves safe tools; dangerous ones may still prompt

text: Permission rules can deny specific tools or command patterns such as rm -rf
quote: { action = "deny",  tool = "bash", pattern = "rm -rf *" },

text: Ask a side question with /btw without interrupting the current task
quote: `/btw <question>` | Ask a side question without interrupting

text: Share the current session via URL
quote: `/share` | Share the current session via URL

text: Automatically saves every conversation to disk, including prompts, responses, tool calls, and file snapshots
quote: Grok saves every conversation to disk automatically — prompts, responses, tool calls, and file snapshots

text: Rewind to an earlier point, restoring files and truncating the conversation to match
quote: Selecting one restores all files to their state at that point and truncates the conversation to match.

text: Fork the current session into a peer session that starts from a copy of the conversation
quote: `/fork [directive]` branches the current session into a peer that starts from a copy of the conversation.

text: Compact conversation history to reclaim context window, with optional preservation instructions
quote: `/compact [context]` compresses the conversation history to reclaim context window, with optional instructions about what to preserve.

text: Agent keeps a structured todo list showing planned, in-progress, and completed work
quote: the agent keeps a structured todo list so you can see what is planned, what is in progress, and what is done.

text: Run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues
quote: Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.

text: /loop runs a prompt on a recurring interval, such as checking tests every 5 minutes
quote: `/loop` runs a prompt on a recurring interval

text: Monitors watch logs, CI runs, or ports and post each output line as a conversation notification
quote: each line the script prints becomes a notification in the conversation. Ask for one when you want to watch a log, a CI run, or a port

text: Fullscreen dashboard shows every session and whether its agent needs input, is working, or is done
quote: The dashboard is a fullscreen overview of every session: which agents need input, which are working, and which are done.

text: Follows coding conventions, build commands, and architecture notes from AGENTS.md automatically each session
quote: Put coding conventions, build and test commands, and architecture notes in an `AGENTS.md` at your repo root, and Grok follows them without being told each session.

text: Reads CLAUDE.md, AGENT.md variants, and .claude/.cursor rules folders for compatibility
quote: Grok reads any of `AGENTS.md`, `Agents.md`, `AGENT.md`, `CLAUDE.md`... (`.claude/rules/` and `.cursor/rules/` are read for compatibility)

text: Import sessions from Claude Code
quote: `grok import [targets...]` | Import sessions from Claude Code

text: Loads existing MCP configurations from Claude, Cursor, and project .mcp.json files
quote: Grok also loads MCP configurations from `~/.claude.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, and project `.mcp.json` files

text: Reads Claude Code and Cursor hook files, including Cursor's camelCase event names
quote: Claude Code (`.claude/settings.json`) and Cursor (`.cursor/hooks.json`) hook files are read as well, including Cursor's camelCase event names.

text: Add MCP servers, including HTTP transport such as Linear, via the CLI
quote: grok mcp add --transport http linear https://mcp.linear.app/mcp

text: Tools from MCP servers become available alongside built-in tools
quote: MCP servers expose external tools to Grok. Once configured, their tools are available alongside the built-in ones

text: Skills are reusable folders of markdown instructions, scripts, and resources for agents
quote: Skills are reusable folders containing markdown instructions, script files, and resources for agents.

text: User-invocable skills appear as slash commands
quote: User-invocable skills also appear as slash commands, for example `/<skill-name>`.

text: Marketplace tab in the TUI for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources
quote: The TUI includes a Marketplace tab for browsing and installing plugins from configured sources.

text: Hooks can block dangerous commands, log tool use, run formatters after edits, or send notifications
quote: block a dangerous command before it runs, log tool use, run a formatter after edits, or send a notification when a turn ends.

text: Subagents run as independent child sessions with their own context and return summaries to the parent
quote: Subagents are independent child sessions with their own context. They return a summary to the parent when finished.

text: Sandbox restricts file read/write and network access using Landlock on Linux and Seatbelt on macOS
quote: The sandbox limits what the agent process and its children can read, write, and reach on the network (Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS).

text: Worktree sessions run in isolated repo copies so parallel agents don't overwrite each other's files
quote: A worktree session runs in an isolated copy of your repository, so parallel agents cannot overwrite each other's files.

text: grok inspect shows discovered config sources, instructions, skills, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers
quote: use `grok inspect` to see what Grok discovered in the current directory, including config sources, instructions, skills, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers

text: Export a session transcript as Markdown
quote: `grok export <session-id> [output]` | Export a session transcript as Markdown

text: Resume recent sessions for the current workspace from a picker
quote: In the TUI, `/resume` opens a picker of recent sessions for the current workspace

text: Device-code authentication for headless or remote environments
quote: `--device-auth` uses device-code authentication for headless or remote environments

text: Configurable color themes via environment variable
quote: `GROK_THEME` | built-in | Color theme.

text: /terminal-setup diagnoses terminal detection and clipboard routes and suggests fixes
quote: Run `/terminal-setup`... inside Grok to see what was detected, which clipboard routes are active, and any issues with fixes.

text: grok wrap runs SSH in a local PTY that intercepts OSC 52 so remote clipboard writes reach your local clipboard
quote: `grok wrap ssh user@host` runs it in a local PTY that intercepts OSC 52 and writes to your clipboard.
